newsitem.title: SWEDEN: RESEARCH ALERT-PAINEWEBBER SAYS ERICSSON TOO HIGH.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PAINEWEBBER SAYS ERICSSON TOO HIGH.

text.p: PaineWebber said on Monday it would keep Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson at 'unattractive' despite the company's strong half-year results last week.

"We initiated with 'unattractive' about a month ago when the share was trading at around $38 or $39 per share. We still see it 'unattractive' even though it had a strong quarter," PaineWebber wireless analyst Walter Piecyk told Reuters.
Ericsson said on Thursday pre-tax profit soared 44 percent to 6.10 billion crowns in the first half of 1997 and said mobile telephone sales rocketed more than 100 percent in the period.

Piecyk said Ericsson was losing market share in every market. He also said Ericsson's increasing importance of mobile handsets to the company was negative because of contracting margins in the business.
